title: On Why IndieWeb
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Bookmarked: On Why IndieWeb

https://chat.indieweb.org/2014-04-24/1398372491000000

tantek With our choice of "Indie Web" we put a stake in the ground. It's a deliberate choice of values, principles, and focus. And by corollary, it is also saying that if all you do is *open* or *federated* or *social* - that is *insufficient*. That is not good enough. You, we must do more.
